rubricName: Security — OWASP Top 10:2025 — Billing-Cycle (Mid-Cycle Subscription Upgrade)

evalCriteria.prompt: Review the two new endpoints (GET /api/billing/upgrade-preview, POST /api/billing/upgrade). Score 0 if either endpoint mutates or discloses billing/plan data for an email without at minimum the same existence check the rest of this codebase already applies (email must be a key in `users`, else 401) — i.e. the new endpoints must not be LESS strict than the existing /api/billing pattern. Cite the file and line.

Review the proration and upgrade logic. Score 0 if: (a) prorated_charge can be computed or applied as a negative/zero-or-less value without the max(1, days_remaining) floor being enforced, (b) an already-Premium account can still trigger a second charge/mutation because the guard is missing or ordered after the side-effecting code, or (c) the upgrade endpoint can be called multiple times to repeatedly re-apply Premium quotas/charges with no idempotency check appropriate to this POC's scope. Cite the file and line.

Review the error paths (402 card_declined, 409 already_premium, 401 unknown email). Score 0 if any error response leaks an internal stack trace, exception message, or implementation detail instead of the documented `detail`/`message` shape, or if an unhandled exception (e.g. a malformed renew_at string) would surface a raw 500 with internal detail instead of a clean, documented error. Cite the file and line.

Review new dependencies added to requirements.txt/package.json for this story. Score 0 if any added package is unpinned with no version specifier where the rest of the file pins versions, or if a payment/network SDK was added where the epic explicitly requires a dependency-free dummy gateway. Cite the file and line.
